build: cargo bench --locked --no-default-features --bench protocol_workloads --no-run; release thin LTO, codegen-units1
method: Alternating unchanged/word-scan-validation binaries on same host. Five timed samples per workload, allocation and destruction included, eight warm-up calls per workload. Server lock held and loopback listener absent. Synthetic workloads only; no end-to-end or hardware-independent guarantee.
library_change: Only PaletteContainer::validate index scanning. Benchmark harness identical.
